definitions.explanation: An expression of congratulation for achievements, special occasions, or celebrations. The polite form is おめでとうございます.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧おめでとう！
⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧おめでとうございます。
あけましておめでとうございます。
⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧おめでとうございます。⟦お{幸|しあわ}せに→幸せ：01420_shiawase⟧。
examples.english: Congratulations on your wedding. Best wishes for your happiness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧おめでとう！⟦これから→これから：01287_korekara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}って→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Congratulations on your graduation! Keep doing your best.

notes:
おめでとう expresses congratulations for achievements or celebrations. From the adjective めでたい (auspicious, happy).

FORMALITY:
- おめでとう: casual (friends, family)
- おめでとうございます: polite (formal situations, superiors)

COMMON OCCASIONS:
- {誕生日|たんじょうび}おめでとう: Happy birthday
- あけましておめでとう: Happy New Year
- {結婚|けっこん}おめでとう: Congratulations on your marriage
- {卒業|そつぎょう}おめでとう: Congratulations on graduation
- {合格|ごうかく}おめでとう: Congratulations on passing

USAGE NOTE:
The occasion word comes first, followed by おめでとう. New Year's greeting is a set phrase: あけましておめでとうございます (lit. "Congratulations on the opening [of the new year]").
